questions.stem: Which of the following numbers is a factor of 168?
questions.solution: 12 is a factor of 168 because 168 divided by 12 equals 14, which is a whole number. 10 is not a factor because 168 divided by 10 leaves a remainder. 14 is not a factor because 168 divided by 14 equals 12, but 14 is not a divisor of 168 in the same way as 12. 16 is not a factor because 168 divided by 16 does not result in a whole number.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी संख्या 168 का गुणनखंड है?
hi.solution: 12, 168 का गुणनखंड है क्योंकि 168 को 12 से विभाजित करने पर 14 प्राप्त होता है, जो एक पूर्ण संख्या है। 10, गुणनखंड नहीं है क्योंकि 168 को 10 से विभाजित करने पर शेष रहता है। 14, गुणनखंड नहीं है क्योंकि 168 को 14 से विभाजित करने पर 12 प्राप्त होता है, लेकिन 14, 168 का विभाजक नहीं है जैसा कि 12 है। 16, गुणनखंड नहीं है क्योंकि 168 को 16 से विभाजित करने पर पूर्ण संख्या प्राप्त नहीं होती।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology in Hindi.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणता संख्या 168 चा अपवर्तक आहे?
mr.solution: 12 हा 168 चा अपवर्तक आहे कारण 168 ला 12 ने भागल्यास 14 मिळतो, जो पूर्ण संख्या आहे. 10 हा अपवर्तक नाही कारण 168 ला 10 ने भागल्यास बाकी राहते. 14 हा अपवर्तक नाही कारण 168 ला 14 ने भागल्यास 12 मिळतो, परंतु 14 हा 168 चा अपवर्तक म्हणून 12 च्या प्रमाणे नाही. 16 हा अपवर्तक नाही कारण 168 ला 16 ने भागल्यास पूर्ण संख्या मिळत नाही.
mr.critique: Translation is accurate, maintains original meaning, and uses standard Marathi mathematical terminology.

questions.stem: What is the definition of co-prime numbers?
choices: Numbers that have at least one common factor
Numbers that have exactly one common factor
Numbers that have no common factors other than 1
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Numbers that have no common factors other than 1'. Co-prime numbers are defined as numbers that share no common factors except 1. The other options incorrectly describe co-prime numbers, either by suggesting they have common factors or by focusing on other properties like being prime.

questions.solution: The number 12 is a multiple of both 3 and 4. 12 ÷ 3 = 4 and 12 ÷ 4 = 3. 18 is not a multiple of 4, 22 is not a multiple of 3, and 28 is not a multiple of 3.

questions.stem: What is the smallest number whose prime factorization has four different prime numbers?

questions.stem: In the 'idli-vada' game, what is the first number for which the players should say 'idli-vada'?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 15 because it is the least common multiple of 3 and 5, meaning it is the first number divisible by both. The number 3 is only divisible by 3, and 5 is only divisible by 5, so they do not meet the condition of being divisible by both. The number 30 is also divisible by both but comes after 15, so it is not the first such number.
